caption: The drawing consists of three main objects arranged vertically on a plain, light beige background. At the top, there is a circular emblem featuring a black butterfly with yellow spots and pink accents on its lower wings, centered above green leaves and a small blue dot, all outlined with a teal border. Below the butterfly emblem, there are two horizontal, oblong beige shapes that are parallel to each other, resembling sticks or elongated bars. The third object, at the bottom, is another circular emblem with a symmetric floral pattern in the center, consisting of dark green, yellow, pink, and brown petal-like shapes radiating from the center, accented by teal and pink dots, and outlined with a teal border similar to the top circle. The objects are spaced apart vertically, with ample empty space surrounding them on the page. There is a small, red text in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Snuff Box
